title: Anoint me with fresh oil

To you, to you, to you.

lyrics:
[Verse]
Anoint me with fresh oil,
Fill me spirit of God. (2)
Help me to see thy purpose,
Understand all thy ways. (2)

[Verse]
I want to get closer Lord,
So much closer, Lord to you;
I want to get closer, Lord,
So much closer, Lord,
To you, to you, to you.
